description: Histograms of the group sum S = sum over a 2x2 or 3x3 group of max(0, d ln B) per window W (keys "W_size"), for 0.9 km pixels drifting 0.41 px/s along track (both directions), B = dark + earthshine x (WAC 643 nm albedo / near-side mean) x Lunar-Lambert shading from LOLA LDEM_64 slopes for the Earth at the sub-Earth point (Earth >10 deg above the horizon, |lat| < 60). Case keys: nominal_* dark 6242 e-/s, m636_* dark 6866 e-/s, pess_* dark 34644 e-/s; I0 = dark + mean earthshine. Bins: edges (log-spaced 1e-6..10, first bin [0,1e-6]). Made with texture_map.py on the team computer, 3 November 2026.
